understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked `+` at the same time; completing all required placements reports WIN and completes the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: A piece could be selected and moved using directional actions or by clicking reachable grid positions. Walls and obstacles blocked movement, and blocked clicks consumed a step without changing the piece’s position. Movement appeared to occur along valid grid paths, with pieces potentially interacting with obstacles or other pieces through pushing when allowed. The step budget was finite, so efficient route planning and avoiding invalid clicks were important.
